reviews.author: Josh Cross
reviews.text: Layne and company built out pool in record time. We were swimming in just over a month from the day we signed a contract. He even checked in on us after the freeze and storms. Great company and people! We love our Bluefin pool and spa.

reviews.author: Pablo Salinas
reviews.text: Bluefin Pools did an outstanding job replastering our pool and after followed up and added the necessary chemicals until the water was in balance. Layne Wilson provided me with the Orenda app, which going forward has been very helpful in adding the correct amount and only the chemicals necessary to keep the pool water balanced, which has saved me a lot of money, have not gone to Warehouse Pool in over a year.

reviews.author: Jadene Van Dorn
reviews.text: Layne with BlueFin Pools has been awesome to work with and has always responded to my questions in a timely manner. The pool was done very quick and only delays were due to weather! The city of Lumberton gave us some issues but Layne and his team quickly came up with some great resolutions that still gave us the beautiful pool we desired. BlueFin Pools is not a done and run business, they are a partner and Layne is still supporting us and and answering any questions we have. I would recommend BlueFin Pools and give them 5 stars!

about.title: We build every pool as the center of your outdoor living
text: BlueFin Pools is a pool construction and outdoor living company serving homeowners, specializing in luxury pools and custom outdoor environments.
We use premium materials and proven construction methods, and we partner with you at every stage so each element fits your goals, lifestyle and investment.
We know the soil, slopes, codes and drainage of the area, and that knowledge goes into every build.
